metadata.title: Eltango | Buenos Aires Style Tango
metadata.description: Eltango, a Buenos Aires style tango studio in Seoul. Learn tango properly, from beginner to master.

hero.title: The Essence of Tango, at Eltango
hero.subtitle: Buenos Aires style tango. Music, connection, partner communication, and a dialogue with the floor — learn it deeply and properly, starting from the fundamentals.

studio.title: Eltango Gangnam HQ
studio.description: Eltango Seoul Tango Academy Gangnam HQ has been running for 16 years as a specialized Argentine tango school in Gangnam. Led by director Lee In-kyung, a 24-year veteran instructor, with over 10,000 cumulative students and 100 monthly active students, Eltango is a renowned tango institution with a structured, level-based curriculum.

curriculum.title: Level-based Curriculum
curriculum.body: From beginner, upper-beginner, intermediate, and advanced adult classes to training tracks, small-group lessons, and professional programs — structured for steady progression.

method.title: Authentic Tango Method
method.body: Taught directly by a 2023 Roma Tango Championship champion, focused on musicality and connection, grounded in authentic method.

lifestyle.title: Gangnam Lifestyle
lifestyle.body: Especially loved by Gangnam professionals in their 30s–40s — an after-work hobby, a new community, and a proper adult tango lesson.

studio.tagline: Looking for a Gangnam tango studio or an adult tango lesson? Start properly at Eltango. Come by for a level consultation and tour our comfortable facilities!
